facts.fact: Decree 25/2025 of 3 March orders the fifth General Population and Housing Census, with the census set for 2027 and preparatory work begun in 2024, per INEGE's director general.
The Scientific Committee validated the project document, communication strategy and resource-mobilisation strategy for the fifth census on 20 August 2026 (reported date).
